fixer.title: ci: run Monaco Editor checks only on pull requests

introducer.title: Move Monaco Editor checks to a separate GH action

cases.mechanism: Each merge to main or release/* generated a second heavyweight Monaco CI run after the pull-request run, repeating dependency/cache/network setup and all compile, bundle, and test subprocesses.
cases.symptom: Unnecessary post-merge runner time, subprocess work, network/cache traffic, and potential GitHub Actions queue contention on every matching push.
cases.fixedBehavior: The workflow now triggers only for pull requests to main or release branches, eliminating one full post-merge CI job per matching branch push while preserving the pre-merge check.
cases.evidence: Base line 4 registered `push` for main/release branches in addition to the unchanged pull_request trigger. The same workflow contains a single job that checks out the repository, restores or installs dependencies, downloads Playwright, runs multiple Monaco compile/distribution/type checks, bundles with webpack, compiles tests, and runs tests. Thus merging a checked PR caused another full run of the same heavyweight job on the resulting branch push; the PR deletes that push trigger while retaining PR validation. Blame identifies the trigger as introduced by d1e59b8fc534fd31a0065820f8697bab503ec28c.
